verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents percentage rollouts, Release Pipelines with stage triggers and actions, a manual kill switch, and an experimentation engine. None of the evidence shows a rollout gated on health or regression metrics that rolls back automatically. The kill switch is a manual toggle and experimentation only reports results; neither delivers automated metric-driven rollback.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can guard a rollout with metrics so a regression is detected and the release is rolled back automatically
